messages:
devon: quick postmortem follow-up from this morning 10min list of owners/timelines for vendor/dependency outages (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). pls ack if you own an item.

devon: proposed actions: (A) thin registry-auth fallback shim + feature-flag, (B) cloud retry/backoff + transient circuit, (C) cheap registry canary + dashboard, (D) recurring vendor-SLA review + quarterly drill.

rita: i'll take A (fallback shim). plan: small adaptor that prefers cached model-metadata when auth errors spike, add ENV toggles and unit + integration tests. aim PR by end of week.

imam: taking B (retry/backoff + circuit). will add conservative exponential backoff and a short-lived circuit that flips to fallback after sustained 5xxs. staging rollout next Tue.

rita: note: add REGISTRY_FALLBACK_MODE=read-cache and a TTL hint header so clients can stretch token TTL ~2m to avoid refresh storms. i'll document hazards in the PR.

imam: i'll coordinate TTL change with the auth team and update PD escalation for a 15m ack SLA on vendor-auth regressions.

devon: C? we need simple telemetry: 5m canary, p95/p99, 5xx-rate, and an explicit `registry_fallback` event so we can query when fallback engaged.

imam: i'll own C in partnership with monitoring. prototype canary job in dev by Friday.

devon: D: ops, let's add a monthly vendor SLA review on the calendar and run a tabletop drill in 3 weeks.

ops-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket "vendor-dep-outage-mitigations-2026Q2" assigned to devon, rita, imam (due 2026-05-10).

rita: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/201 1 includes feature-flag and tests.

imam: ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-6301 1 links to PRs and rollout plan.

devon: please add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri; i'll aggregate into the follow-up tracker and share with leadership. if timelines shift ping me. :white_check_mark:
